rubric_items.deep_module: pass — imas_ambix/plot_style.py hides the data-ink sheet application and the per-component colour roles behind named role symbols, and the two figure scripts follow the repo's established scripts/figures_*.py convention, so complexity is not spread across shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3 re-derives the EDDB cache layout owned by imas_ambix/data/eddb.py and states it in prose ("one {shot}.zarr per pulse laid out {category}/{dname} with a sibling {dname}_time array and the EDDB unit string as an attribute") rather than naming the owner it should extend; §1/§3 also hardcode /work/projects/imas_gpu/jt60sa/* beside the owner imas_ambix/data/paths.py (JT60SA_ROOT, JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR).
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §1 adds a new public module imas_ambix/plot_style.py with named public colour-role definitions and does not name what it retires or merges, or state why nothing can be, as the rule requires of a section adding to the public_definitions family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites no search for two mechanisms that already exist in the codebases it names: the EDDB cache reader imas_ambix/data/eddb.py (which owns the {shot}.zarr/{category}/{dname} layout, the _time sibling suffix and the units attribute the plan restates) and the machine-description acquisition route imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py; only §1's "no style module yet" claim (true) is a search result.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no proposed layer wraps existing machinery: no shared style module exists to extend (data-ink is installed as a sheet, not a Python module), and the two scripts sit beside, not over, eddb.py and description_reader.py, so a wrapper-without-justification is not what is wrong here (the duplication is).
